# betterado_profile (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an Azure DevOps user profile. Use `id = "me"` to fetch the authenticated user's own profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the authenticated user's profile
data "betterado_profile" "me" {
  id = "me"
}

output "display_name" {
  value = data.betterado_profile.me.display_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The profile identity to look up. Use `"me"` for the authenticated user.

### Optional

- `avatar_url` (String) Base64-encoded PNG avatar of the profile. May be empty if the user has no custom avatar.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the profile.
- `email_address` (String) The email address of the profile.
- `public_alias` (String) The public alias of the profile.
